meta.independent_real_cli_runs_note: This harness never executes the Claude CLI. Every number here replays recorded outcomes; independent real CLI runs are produced only by caver8.live and are NOT part of this report.
meta.replay_caveat: Replay draws the same 60 recorded outcomes ([2] per configuration) again and again. Seed CIs capture schedule and policy randomness only, NOT the uncertainty of the recorded observations themselves.
meta.salt_note: SEALED v0.9 final holdout, explicitly unsealed (see final_unseal_log.jsonl)

recovery.description: caver8: W_BASE 1-30, W_SHIFT 31-60, fresh W_BASE cohort 61-90 (legacy recovery horizon runs to step 90)

gradual.description: gradual drift: P(case from W_SHIFT cohort) rises linearly from 0 after step 15 to 1 at step 75 (p_t = clip((t-15)/60, 0, 1)); change point = drift onset 15

double.description: double shift to a different family set: W_BASE 1-30, W_SHIFT 31-60, W_ALT 61-90 (W_ALT up-weights field_value and timeout vs W_SHIFT)

single.description: shift toward a single family: W_BASE 1-30, then W_SINGLE (timeout 0.75, others 0.05) 31-90

meta.budget_check: asserted per run: selects == updates == train + eval
meta.recovery_definition: per shift event: eval probes after the change point until the first unique defect in an up-weighted family, within the event horizon; censored runs count as cap = horizon - change + 1 (restricted mean); run value = mean over events; recovery_censored_rate = share of runs with any censored event
meta.false_alarm_definition: share of detector runs with >= 1 alarm at eval_step <= false_alarm_until_step
meta.cpu_us_per_probe: process CPU time inside select + observe_outcome + update, per probe (not deterministic)
meta.ci: normal approx, mean +/- 1.96 sd/sqrt(n); paired differences on matched seeds
